label: Google Business Profile
terms_note: Business Profile content policy: no misleading offers, no keyword stuffing; review replies are public. 300 QPM once approved.

sdks: google-api-python-client (discovery: mybusiness v4, mybusinessbusinessinformation v1, businessprofileperformance v1, mybusinessqanda v1)

auth: 1. Google Cloud project → **Application for Basic API Access** form (GBP API contact form) with the project number;
2. Enable the Business Profile APIs, OAuth 2.0 web client, scope `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/business.manage`.
3. Each tenant connects their own owner / manager Google account (refresh token stored per account); accounts →

endpoints.notes: OFFER, event{title, schedule{startDate, endDate…}}, offer{couponCode, redeemOnlineUrl, termsConditions}, callToAction{actionType, url}, media[{mediaFormat PHOTO, sourceUrl}]}

reference.limits: - 300 QPM per approved project (raise via the quota form); Google API Services policies. - Business Profile content policy: no misleading offers, no keyword stuffing; review replies are public.

fields.name: client_id
fields.help: OAuth 2.0 client id (Google Cloud console, Clients page) of the app the user consented to.

fields.name: client_secret
fields.help: The OAuth client's secret; sent with client_id, refresh_token and grant_type=refresh_token in the form body of POST https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token (https://developers.google.com/identity/protocols/oauth2/web-server#offline).

fields.name: refresh_token
fields.help: Refresh token from a one-time authorization-code consent with access_type=offline and the scopes https://www.googleapis.com/auth/business.manage. 'Refresh tokens are valid until the user revokes access or the refresh token expires'; the runtime mints 1-hour access tokens from it.

config_fields.name: account_id
config_fields.help: Business Profile account id (digits after accounts/ in GET https://mybusinessaccountmanagement.googleapis.com/v1/accounts).

config_fields.name: location_id
config_fields.help: Location id (digits after locations/) of the verified location that posts and reviews belong to.

config_fields.name: language_code
config_fields.help: languageCode of new local posts, e.g. en-US (optional).

me.note: accounts.list: the Business Profile accounts the user can manage (use the digits of `name` as account_id).

publish_text.note: localPosts.create with topicType STANDARD and summary = text; id is the post resource name accounts/…/locations/…/localPosts/…. `reply_to` is ignored.

publish_image.note: localPosts.create with media [{mediaFormat: PHOTO, sourceUrl}] (https://developers.google.com/my-business/content/posts-data); only the first image URL is sent and Google fetches it.

read_mentions.note: The location's customer REVIEWS are returned as mentions (newest first; starRating and reviewReply in raw). Valid only for verified locations; 'The maximum pageSize is 50'; pages by pageToken, so `page`/`since` are ignored.

reply_comment.note: Replies to a REVIEW (`comment_id` = reviewId from read_mentions); 'A reply is created if one does not exist', otherwise it is replaced. A review has one reply, so `id` is a fixed marker.

delete.note: `post_id` is the numeric local post id (the last segment of the post name).

not_offered.read_comments: Local posts carry no comments in the LocalPost resource (https://developers.google.com/my-business/reference/rest/v4/accounts.locations.localPosts); customer feedback is reviews, exposed as read_mentions.
not_offered.analytics_post: localPosts.reportInsights is a location-wide POST taking localPostNames plus a basicRequest with metricRequests and a timeRange (https://developers.google.com/my-business/reference/rest/v4/accounts.locations.localPosts/reportInsights); the vocabulary carries no time range.

evidence: host mybusiness.googleapis.com: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (Google Trust Services)
probe: 6/6 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route -> 404 (not_found), so the answers are path-specific
spec https://mybusinessaccountmanagement.googleapis.com/$discovery/rest?version=v1: 1/1 tools match (path, method, parameters, body keys, response paths)
